issue_request: FHIR-6389 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Conformance. It asked for a way to programmatically identify FHIR registries and resolved to add Conformance.instantiates as Reference(Conformance)|uri 0..* for services a server implements or complies with.

additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source defines CapabilityStatement.instantiates as a 0..* canonical reference to CapabilityStatement with service-oriented semantics. Later cleanup such as FHIR-39433 clarified that CapabilityStatement.instantiates, not implementationGuide, is the way to assert conformance to IG-defined CapabilityStatements.
